passages.heading: <big> HTML bigger text element
passages.text: Avoid using this feature in new projects. This feature may be a candidate for removal from web standards or browsers. See full compatibility Learn more The <big> HTML deprecated element renders the enclosed text at a font size one level larger than the surrounding text ( medium becomes large, for example). The size is capped at the browser's maximum permitted font size. Warning: This element has been removed from the specification and shouldn't be used anymore. Use the CSS font-size property to adjust the font size.

passages.heading: Attributes
passages.text: This element has no other attributes than the global attributes, common to all elements.

passages.heading: Examples
passages.text: Here we see examples showing the use of <big> followed by an example showing how to accomplish the same results using modern CSS syntax instead.
